quests.title: Accounting Detective Case
quests.description: Solve financial mysteries using accounting principles and detective skills!

story.introduction: The Financial Crime Investigation Unit needs your accounting expertise! Solve cases involving missing money and incorrect records.

steps.title: The Trial Balance Mystery
steps.narrative: A company's trial balance doesn't match! Find the errors and restore financial order.

problem.question: If the trial balance shows a difference of ₹500 (credit side excess), what could be a possible error?
problem.explanation: If credit side is excess by ₹500, either a debit entry is missing or understated, or a credit entry is overstated.
